text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Buzzing with excitement, Ines Fujin<n>holds nothing
back during the Asahi<n>Hai F.S. As a result, however,
she<n>collapses shortly after crossing the<n>finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Still, it looks like her passionate<n>performance has lit
up the hearts of<n>countless rivals and spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
For our next race, we choose the<n>Satsuki Sho—the
first step of the<n>Classic Triple Crown tour that
includes our main goal, the Japanese<n>Derby. I'm
sure Ines Fujin's<n>performance there will attract
plenty<n>of attention.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The people close to Ines Fujin also<n>see her in a
different light now. At<n>work, her manager suggests
that she<n>should quit for now to focus on<n>racing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While she does want to continue<n>working to
support her sisters, Ines<n>Fujin worries how I might
feel about<n>the prospect.
